explain.ADD: Adds {1} to {0}; the sum goes to {0} and the flags are updated.
explain.ADC: Adds {1} and the carry flag to {0}.
explain.SUB: Subtracts {1} from {0}; the result goes to {0} and the flags are updated.
explain.SBB: Subtracts {1} and the carry flag from {0}.
explain.CMP: Compares {0} with {1} (subtracts without storing); only the flags change, for a following conditional jump.
explain.AND: Bitwise AND of {0} and {1}; the result goes to {0}.
explain.OR: Bitwise OR of {0} and {1}; the result goes to {0}.
explain.XOR: Bitwise XOR of {0} and {1}; the result goes to {0} (XOR with itself clears it).
explain.TEST: Bitwise AND of {0} and {1} without storing; only the flags change.
explain.MUL: Unsigned multiply of AL or AX by {0}; the result goes to AX (byte) or DX:AX (word).
explain.IMUL: Signed multiply of AL or AX by {0}; the result goes to AX (byte) or DX:AX (word).
explain.DIV: Unsigned divide of AX or DX:AX by {0}; quotient in AL/AX, remainder in AH/DX.
explain.IDIV: Signed divide of AX or DX:AX by {0}; quotient in AL/AX, remainder in AH/DX.
explain.PUSH: SP goes down by 2 and {0} is stored at the new top of the stack.
explain.POP: The word at the top of the stack is copied into {0} and SP goes up by 2.
explain.PUSHF: Stores the flags register on the stack.
explain.POPF: Loads the flags register from the stack.
explain.CALL: Pushes the return address and jumps to {0}; RET comes back to the next line.
explain.RET: Pops the return address from the stack and continues there.
explain.RETF: Pops IP and CS from the stack (far return).
explain.IRET: Returns from an interrupt: pops IP, CS and the flags.
explain.jcc: {1} jumps to {0} if its condition on the flags holds; otherwise the next line runs.
explain.LOOP: CX ({1}) goes down by 1; if it is not zero, jumps to {0}.
explain.LOOPE: CX ({1}) goes down by 1; jumps to {0} if CX is not zero and ZF = 1.
explain.LOOPNE: CX ({1}) goes down by 1; jumps to {0} if CX is not zero and ZF = 0.
explain.JCXZ: Jumps to {0} if CX ({1}) is zero.
explain.INT: Calls interrupt {0}; with AH = {1} this selects the BIOS/DOS function (see Help > Reference).
explain.LEA: Puts the address of {1} (not its value) into {0}.
explain.CBW: Extends the sign of AL into AH.
explain.CWD: Extends the sign of AX into DX.
explain.CLD: Clears the direction flag: string instructions move forwards.
explain.STD: Sets the direction flag: string instructions move backwards.
explain.LODSB: Loads the byte at DS:SI into AL and moves SI.
explain.LODSW: Loads the word at DS:SI into AX and moves SI.
explain.STOSB: Stores AL at ES:DI and moves DI.
explain.STOSW: Stores AX at ES:DI and moves DI.
explain.MOVSB: Copies the byte at DS:SI to ES:DI and moves both.
explain.MOVSW: Copies the word at DS:SI to ES:DI and moves both.
explain.CMPSB: Compares the bytes at DS:SI and ES:DI and moves both.
explain.CMPSW: Compares the words at DS:SI and ES:DI and moves both.
explain.SCASB: Compares AL with the byte at ES:DI and moves DI.
explain.SCASW: Compares AX with the word at ES:DI and moves DI.
explain.XLAT: Replaces AL with the byte at DS:[BX+AL] (table lookup).
